title: build-wsl.sh --help launches configure/build instead of printing usage
body: The documented build wrapper has no help/usage exit: ./build-wsl.sh --help configured and launched a Debug build, passing --help into cmake --build. This can bypass the live queue if used as an invocation probe. Add a help branch before configure and document the supported Release form. Tier: luna; effort: S. Exact failed command: ./build-wsl.sh --help. Workaround: inspect the script directly and use the queued Release invocation.

title: lookdev CTest capture registration does not build its capture executable
body: The generated CTest entry Application.LookdevCapture.Presentation.midday failed before execution because vixen_lookdev_capture was absent (run_lookdev_capture.cmake:36 reported no such file or directory). The witness needed a separate queued ./build-wsl.sh --target vixen_lookdev_capture -j4 before retrying. Make the capture tests depend on the producer target or make the documented witness command build that prerequisite. Tier: luna; effort: S.

title: standalone editor agent-channel witness lacks the generated Vulkan GPU environment
body: drive_panels.py failed when run directly through the live GPU queue with VK_ERROR_INCOMPATIBLE_DRIVER because it only set DISPLAY and VK_ICD_FILENAMES; CTest also supplies VK_LAYER_PATH, LD_LIBRARY_PATH, VIXEN_GPU_WITNESS, and VK_ADD_IMPLICIT_LAYER_PATH. The witness had to copy those generated CTest values manually before it could launch two editor processes. Export or reuse the supported GPU environment in the agent-channel harness. Tier: luna; effort: S.
